newsitem.title: USA: PHLX appoints committee to review its governance.
newsitem.headline: PHLX appoints committee to review its governance.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Wednesday it appointed a special committee to review its governance structure.

The exchange said the committee, headed by Irving Pollack, a former commissioner at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, will also study its operations and the makeup of its board of governors, committees and other groups involved in its governance.
The committee will solicit input from PHLX members, member firms and the investment community and submit a written report to the board of governors in the spring of 1997.
A spokeswoman for the exchange said the formation of the governance committee grew out of a recommendation from a special committee that was put together earlier this year.

That committee investigated whether former chairman Vincent Casella improperly benefited from his ownership of shares in Ashton Technology Group Inc, which was hired by the PHLX to build an electronic trading system.
Casella resigned in October as the board of governors heard the special committee's report.
